plan.archetype: Early burst and AoE transitioning into poison and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Bring AoE for both followers, sustained poison for the priest, efficient block and weakness, strong entry HP, and two useful potions.
plan.summary: Secure early damage before taking elites. Add poison scaling and dexterity-backed defense, then remove Strikes. Upgrade core cards when healthy; use needed rests to grow maximum HP.

plan.archetype: Group poison scaling with weakness and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Enter healthy, establish Fumes early, eliminate followers with group damage, and time Wails against multihits. Use the poison potion to shorten dangerous enemy survival.
plan.summary: Heal now for Kin. Afterwards add poison acceleration, dexterity, and efficient draw; remove Strikes. Upgrade Fumes and core scaling when healthy, and avoid elites until damage and defense improve.

plan.archetype: Accelerated group poison with dexterity and weakness defense
plan.bossPrep: Enter healthy with upgraded poison scaling, reliable block, and potions. Establish poison on both crab parts; manage facing and reserve Wails for dangerous attacks.
plan.summary: Prioritize faster poison damage and dexterity. Avoid elites, use three rests and the shop, remove Strikes, and upgrade Accelerant, Fumes, or Footwork when Feather healing permits.
